title: anyone else not lost in the mall?
content: So as I was reading people's experiences in the mall, my experiences lined up enough with most people. Except one thing that personally stuck out. When ever I dream I'm there, lost is the last thing I have ever felt. I'm later baffled that it felt so familiar and routine. Which is why I figured I had created this mall in my own head. When I read that people were feeling lost that seemed strange to me based off of my own memory-feelings. Because I would compare the feeling of returning to your hometown. Nostalgic is a better word for it actually. In my dreams I hang around in there with no goal of getting anything, or talking to anyone. I guess you'd call it window shopping. Or those people that do laps around the mall. Every time at some point after a normal stroll I stop somewhere around the glass elevator near a large potted plant and I'm sitting on the floor 100% comfortable. As comfortable as I'm walking around my own house. Any thoughts on this? And for those who feel lost everytime, do you think you are looking for something?
